item.title: CoreCivic receives Leavenworth planning commission approval in contentious meeting
item.description: CoreCivic is a step closer to reopening its private prison in Leavenworth as a lucrative immigration detention center after the city planning commission approved a special use permit over objections from local advocates. Continue reading ...

item.title: Fundraisers for the Lawrence Arts Center offer a smorgasbord of culinary-themed creations
item.description: As football fans gear up for the 60th Super Bowl, Lawrencians are readying their utensils for an annual soup and ceramics jubilee. The Lawrence Arts Center's Souper Bowl is set for Saturday. Continue reading ...

item.title: City Commission pledges tax breaks for west Lawrence affordable housing project
item.description: A majority of Lawrence city commissioners on Tuesday pledged their support for tax breaks to offset development costs of an affordable housing project planned for the far western edge of town. Continue reading ...

item.title: Kansas GOP House members renew attacks on DEI, CRT at public universities
item.description: Kansas House Republicans stirred an academic hornet’s nest Tuesday with a bill imposing a ban on diversity, equity and inclusion as well as critical race theory in most classes counted toward degree requirements at the state’s public universities. Continue reading ...

item.title: KU faculty union still without contract nearly two years in; city commissioner urges progress
item.description: Contract negotiations between KU’s administration and faculty union remain stalled after more than 600 days of bargaining, and a Lawrence city commissioner has joined those urging KU to end the delays. Continue reading ...

item.title: Camp sweep near I-70 in Lawrence leaves people asking where else they can go
item.description: People living in tents and hand-built structures near Interstate 70 in Lawrence were forced to vacate the property in the cold during a camp sweep Wednesday. Many had their possessions destroyed and don’t know where they can go next. Continue reading ...
